title: Averages: Mean, Totals and Missing Values
seo_title: Averages – Primary 6 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Find the mean (average) of a set of data; find the total from the average; find a missing value; find how the average changes. (summary of the NERDC Primary 6 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 6 maths worksheets on averages: finding the mean, the total from the mean, a missing value, and how the average changes when a value is added. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Average (mean) = total of all values ÷ number of values.
  • If you know the average, the total = average × number of values.
  • To find a missing value, subtract the known values from the total.

Examples

Example

Average of 4 numbers is 15; three are 12, 18, 10

Total = 60

60 − 40

Answer: 20

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing by the wrong numberCount every value, including zeros.
Forgetting to find the totalMost average problems start with the total.
Thinking the average must be one of the valuesIt need not be.

faq.q: What is another name for average?
Can the average be a decimal?

faq.a: For test scores, rainfall and temperatures.

items.q: Simi scored 10, 13, 15 and 14 marks in 4 spelling tests. Each test was out of 20. What was her average mark?
items.e: Total: 10 + 13 + 15 + 14 = 52. There are 4 tests. Average = 52 ÷ 4 = 13.

items.q: Ada read 40, 17, 32, 20 and 21 pages of a storybook on 5 nights. What was the average number of pages per night?
items.e: Total: 40 + 17 + 32 + 20 + 21 = 130. There are 5 nights. Average = 130 ÷ 5 = 26.

items.q: The numbers of pupils absent from Class 6A on 5 days were 1, 0, 3, 1 and 5. What was the average number of pupils absent per day?
items.e: Total: 1 + 0 + 3 + 1 + 5 = 10. There are 5 days (the 0 counts too). Average = 10 ÷ 5 = 2.

items.q: Three parcels have masses of 1 kg 135 g, 1 kg 675 g and 775 g. What is the average mass of a parcel?
The school football team scored 0, 5, 4, 4 and 2 goals in 5 matches. What was the average number of goals per match?
items.e: Total: 0 + 5 + 4 + 4 + 2 = 15. There are 5 matches (the 0 counts too). Average = 15 ÷ 5 = 3.

items.q: The numbers of pupils who went to the library during recess on 6 days were 38, 20, 29, 28, 40 and 25. What was the average number of pupils per day?
The masses of 4 durians are 1.6, 1.2, 2.6 and 1.4 kg. What is the average mass of a durian?
items.e: Total: 1.6 + 1.2 + 2.6 + 1.4 = 6.8. There are 4 durians. Average = 6.8 ÷ 4 = 1.7 kg.

items.q: Four bottles hold 1 litre 250 ml, 950 ml, 1 litre 700 ml and 1 litre 500 ml of water. What is the average volume of water in a bottle?
items.e: Change to millilitres: 1,250 + 950 + 1,700 + 1,500 = 5,400 ml. Average = 5,400 ml ÷ 4 = 1,350 ml = 1 litre 350 ml.

items.q: The heights of 4 pupils are 1.55, 1.52, 1.53 and 1.60 m. What is their average height?
The bar graph shows the number of pupils absent from Class 6B each day. What was the average number of pupils absent per day?
items.e: Total: 1 + 0 + 6 + 2 + 1 = 10. There are 5 days (the 0 counts too). Average = 10 ÷ 5 = 2.

items.q: Mr Bello walked 12,410, 10,416, 8,301 and 9,501 steps on 4 days. What was the average number of steps he walked per day?
A school weather station recorded 27.0, 10.3, 27.1, 13.0 and 36.3 mm of rain on 5 days. What was the average daily rainfall?
The bar graph shows the number of cups of bubble tea a shop sold from Monday to Friday. What was the average number of cups sold per day?
items.e: Total: 70 + 50 + 70 + 80 + 60 = 330. There are 5 days. Average = 330 ÷ 5 = 66.

items.q: A school concert was held on 3 nights. The audience on the 3 nights was 1,201, 1,157 and 1,467 people. What was the average audience per night?
What was the average time taken by the 4 pupils?
Yusuf scored 11, 16, 20 and 13 marks in 4 spelling tests. Each test was out of 20. What was his average mark?
items.e: Total: 11 + 16 + 20 + 13 = 60. There are 4 tests. Average = 60 ÷ 4 = 15.

items.q: Obinna read 16, 41, 43, 40 and 30 pages of a storybook on 5 nights. What was the average number of pages per night?
items.e: Total: 16 + 41 + 43 + 40 + 30 = 170. There are 5 nights. Average = 170 ÷ 5 = 34.

items.q: The numbers of pupils absent from Class 6A on 5 days were 5, 5, 0, 4 and 1. What was the average number of pupils absent per day?
items.e: Total: 5 + 5 + 0 + 4 + 1 = 15. There are 5 days (the 0 counts too). Average = 15 ÷ 5 = 3.

items.q: Three parcels have masses of 970 g, 1 kg 50 g and 1 kg 520 g. What is the average mass of a parcel?
The school football team scored 4, 0, 5, 1 and 5 goals in 5 matches. What was the average number of goals per match?
items.e: Total: 4 + 0 + 5 + 1 + 5 = 15. There are 5 matches (the 0 counts too). Average = 15 ÷ 5 = 3.

items.q: The average of three numbers is 34. What is the total of the three numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 34 × 3 = 102.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 46. What is the total of the four numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 46 × 4 = 184.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 57. What is the total of the five numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 57 × 5 = 285.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 89. What is the total of the six numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 89 × 6 = 534.

items.q: The average mass of 8 bags of rice is 2.51 kg. What is the total mass of the bags?
items.e: Total value = average × number of bags = 2.51 kg × 8 = 20.08 kg.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 22.9. What is the total of the four numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 22.9 × 4 = 91.6.

items.q: The average length of 6 ribbons is 17.9 cm. What is the total length of the ribbons?
items.e: Total value = average × number of ribbons = 17.9 cm × 6 = 107.4 cm.

items.q: Ada spent an average of 75 min a day reading for 5 days. How much time did she spend altogether? Give your answer in hours and minutes.
items.e: Total = 75 min × 5 = 375 min. 375 min = 6 × 60 min + 15 min = 6 h 15 min.

items.q: The average of eight numbers is 31.6. What is the total of the eight numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 31.6 × 8 = 252.8.

items.q: The average amount of water in 6 cups is 300 ml. How much water is there altogether?
items.e: Total = 300 ml × 6 = 1,800 ml = 1 litre 800 ml.

items.q: The average height of 4 pupils in a relay team is 1.47 m. What is their total height?
items.e: Total value = average × number of pupils = 1.47 m × 4 = 5.88 m.

items.q: Obinna’s total score in some tests was 385 marks. His average score was 77 marks. How many tests did he take?
items.e: Number of tests = total ÷ average = 385 ÷ 77 = 5.

items.q: Some boxes have a total mass of 22.4 kg. The average mass of a box is 2.8 kg. How many boxes are there?
items.e: Number of boxes = total ÷ average = 22.4 ÷ 2.8 = 8.

items.q: The average distance Emeka jogged each day for 7 days at East Coast Park was 4.3 km. How far did he jog altogether?
items.e: Total value = average × number of days = 4.3 km × 7 = 30.1 km.

items.q: Ibrahim spent an average of 40 min a day practising the piano for a week. How much time did he spend altogether? Give your answer in hours and minutes.
items.e: Total = 40 min × 7 = 280 min. 280 min = 4 × 60 min + 40 min = 4 h 40 min.

items.q: A class collected 128 cans for recycling. On average, each pupil collected 4 cans. How many pupils are in the class?
items.e: Number of pupils = total ÷ average = 128 ÷ 4 = 32.

items.q: The average of three numbers is 63. What is the total of the three numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 63 × 3 = 189.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 58. What is the total of the four numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 58 × 4 = 232.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 61. What is the total of the five numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 61 × 5 = 305.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 33. What is the total of the six numbers?
items.e: Total value = average × number of numbers = 33 × 6 = 198.

items.q: The average of three numbers is 24. Two of the numbers are 19 and 12. What is the missing number?
items.e: Total of all 3 numbers = 24 × 3 = 72. The 2 numbers given add up to 19 + 12 = 31. Missing number = 72 − 31 = 41.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 16. Three of the numbers are 5, 27 and 12. What is the missing number?
items.e: Total of all 4 numbers = 16 × 4 = 64. The 3 numbers given add up to 5 + 27 + 12 = 44. Missing number = 64 − 44 = 20.

items.q: The average of two numbers is 72. One of the numbers is 28. What is the other number?
items.e: Total = 2 × 72 = 144. Other number = 144 − 28 = 116.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 33. Three of the numbers are 24, 32 and 30. What is the missing number?
items.e: Total of all 4 numbers = 33 × 4 = 132. The 3 numbers given add up to 24 + 32 + 30 = 86. Missing number = 132 − 86 = 46.

items.q: Femi’s average mark for 3 tests was 71. His marks for 2 of the tests were 90 and 61. What was his mark for the other test?
items.e: Total for 3 tests = 71 × 3 = 213. Known marks: 90 + 61 = 151. Other test = 213 − 151 = 62.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 27. Four of the numbers are 17, 25, 28 and 26. What is the missing number?
items.e: Total of all 5 numbers = 27 × 5 = 135. The 4 numbers given add up to 17 + 25 + 28 + 26 = 96. Missing number = 135 − 96 = 39.

items.q: Nkechi’s marks for 3 Science tests were 69, 81 and 66. What mark must she get in the next test so that her average mark for all 4 tests is 77?
items.e: Total needed for 4 tests = 4 × 77 = 308. Total so far = 69 + 81 + 66 = 216. Musa needed = 308 − 216 = 92.

items.q: The bar for Friday is missing. The average number of books borrowed per day was 33. How many books were borrowed on Friday?
items.e: Total = 33 × 5 = 165. The other bars add up to 35 + 25 + 30 + 45 = 135. Friday: 165 − 135 = 30.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 64. Four of the numbers are 56, 52, 69 and 66. What is the missing number?
items.e: Total of all 5 numbers = 64 × 5 = 320. The 4 numbers given add up to 56 + 52 + 69 + 66 = 243. Missing number = 320 − 243 = 77.

items.q: The average of two numbers is 29. One of the numbers is 21.9. What is the other number?
Hauwa’s average mark for 4 tests was 76. Her marks for 3 of the tests were 82, 71 and 87. What was her mark for the other test?
items.e: Total for 4 tests = 76 × 4 = 304. Known marks: 82 + 71 + 87 = 240. Other test = 304 − 240 = 64.

items.q: The average of three numbers A, B and C is 48. The average of A and B is 45. What is C?
Kemi’s marks for 4 Science tests were 70, 72, 69 and 81. What mark must she get in the next test so that her average mark for all 5 tests is 76?
items.e: Total needed for 5 tests = 5 × 76 = 380. Total so far = 70 + 72 + 69 + 81 = 292. Musa needed = 380 − 292 = 88.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 78. Five of the numbers are 69, 66, 71, 68 and 84. What is the missing number?
items.e: Total of all 6 numbers = 78 × 6 = 468. The 5 numbers given add up to 69 + 66 + 71 + 68 + 84 = 358. Missing number = 468 − 358 = 110.

items.q: The bar for May is missing. The average rainfall for the 5 months was 210 mm. What was the rainfall in May?
Bayo’s average mark for 5 tests was 78. His marks for 4 of the tests were 79, 75, 70 and 68. What was his mark for the other test?
items.e: Total for 5 tests = 78 × 5 = 390. Known marks: 79 + 75 + 70 + 68 = 292. Other test = 390 − 292 = 98.

items.q: The average of three numbers A, B and C is 53. The average of A and B is 49. What is C?
Ruth’s marks for 4 Science tests were 69, 71, 90 and 82. What mark must she get in the next test so that her average mark for all 5 tests is 82?
items.e: Total needed for 5 tests = 5 × 82 = 410. Total so far = 69 + 71 + 90 + 82 = 312. Musa needed = 410 − 312 = 98.

items.q: The average of three numbers A, B and C is 69. The average of A and B is 71. What is C?
The average of 5 numbers is 56. The average of the first 3 numbers is 64. What is the average of the last 2 numbers?
items.e: Total of 5 numbers = 5 × 56 = 280. Total of first 3 = 3 × 64 = 192. Last 2 add up to 280 − 192 = 88. Average = 88 ÷ 2 = 44.

items.q: The average of three numbers is 11. The number 51 is added to the group. What is the average of the four numbers now?
items.e: Old total = 11 × 3 = 33. New total = 33 + 51 = 84. New average = 84 ÷ 4 = 21.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 30. The number 24 is removed. What is the average of the remaining three numbers?
items.e: Old total = 30 × 4 = 120. New total = 120 − 24 = 96. New average = 96 ÷ 3 = 32.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 39. The number 34 is added to the group. What is the average of the five numbers now?
items.e: Old total = 39 × 4 = 156. New total = 156 + 34 = 190. New average = 190 ÷ 5 = 38.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 34. The number 74 is removed. What is the average of the remaining four numbers?
items.e: Old total = 34 × 5 = 170. New total = 170 − 74 = 96. New average = 96 ÷ 4 = 24.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 13. The number 18 is added to the group. What is the average of the five numbers now?
items.e: Old total = 13 × 4 = 52. New total = 52 + 18 = 70. New average = 70 ÷ 5 = 14.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 39. When one more number is added, the average becomes 44. What is the number that was added?
items.e: Old total = 4 × 39 = 156. New total = 5 × 44 = 220. Number added = 220 − 156 = 64.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 38. The number 6 is removed. What is the average of the remaining four numbers?
items.e: Old total = 38 × 5 = 190. New total = 190 − 6 = 184. New average = 184 ÷ 4 = 46.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 27. The number 9 is added to the group. What is the average of the six numbers now?
items.e: Old total = 27 × 5 = 135. New total = 135 + 9 = 144. New average = 144 ÷ 6 = 24.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 19. When one more number is added, the average becomes 23. What is the number that was added?
items.e: Old total = 5 × 19 = 95. New total = 6 × 23 = 138. Number added = 138 − 95 = 43.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 49. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining numbers is 52. What number was removed?
items.e: Old total = 5 × 49 = 245. New total = 4 × 52 = 208. Number removed = 245 − 208 = 37.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 41. The number 51 is removed. What is the average of the remaining five numbers?
items.e: Old total = 41 × 6 = 246. New total = 246 − 51 = 195. New average = 195 ÷ 5 = 39.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 15. The number 36 is added to the group. What is the average of the seven numbers now?
items.e: Old total = 15 × 6 = 90. New total = 90 + 36 = 126. New average = 126 ÷ 7 = 18.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 47. When one more number is added, the average becomes 51. What is the number that was added?
items.e: Old total = 6 × 47 = 282. New total = 7 × 51 = 357. Number added = 357 − 282 = 75.

items.q: The average of six numbers is 40. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining numbers is 37. What number was removed?
items.e: Old total = 6 × 40 = 240. New total = 5 × 37 = 185. Number removed = 240 − 185 = 55.

items.q: The average of seven numbers is 34. When one more number is added, the average becomes 36. What is the number that was added?
items.e: Old total = 7 × 34 = 238. New total = 8 × 36 = 288. Number added = 288 − 238 = 50.

items.q: The average of eight numbers is 58. When one number is removed, the average of the remaining numbers is 62. What number was removed?
items.e: Old total = 8 × 58 = 464. New total = 7 × 62 = 434. Number removed = 464 − 434 = 30.

items.q: Uju’s average score for 4 spelling tests was 15. Each test was out of 20. Later, her teacher found that one score of 12 should be 20. What is the correct average score?
items.e: The total increases by 20 − 12 = 8. Shared among 4 tests, the average increases by 8 ÷ 4 = 2. Correct average = 15 + 2 = 17.

items.q: The average of four numbers is 27. When one more number is added, the average increases by 2. What is the number that was added?
items.e: New average = 27 + 2 = 29. New total = 5 × 29 = 145. Old total = 4 × 27 = 108. Number added = 145 − 108 = 37.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 22. When one more number is added, the average increases by 4. What is the number that was added?
items.e: New average = 22 + 4 = 26. New total = 6 × 26 = 156. Old total = 5 × 22 = 110. Number added = 156 − 110 = 46.

items.q: Emeka’s average score for 5 spelling tests was 13. Each test was out of 20. Later, his teacher found that one score of 9 should be 19. What is the correct average score?
items.e: The total increases by 19 − 9 = 10. Shared among 5 tests, the average increases by 10 ÷ 5 = 2. Correct average = 13 + 2 = 15.

items.q: The average age of 3 brothers is 9 years now. What will their average age be in 4 years’ time?
items.e: Each brother will be 4 years older, so the average also goes up by 4: 9 + 4 = 13 years. (Total now = 27; total then = 27 + 3 × 4 = 39; 39 ÷ 3 = 13.)

items.q: During one week in December, the average daily rainfall for the first 4 days was 12.6 mm. The average daily rainfall for the last 3 days was 4.2 mm. What was the average daily rainfall for the whole week?
items.e: First 4 days: 4 × 12.6 = 50.4 mm. Last 3 days: 3 × 4.2 = 12.6 mm. Total = 63 mm. Average = 63 ÷ 7 = 9 mm.

items.q: The average age of a family of 4 is 22 years. When their grandmother joins them, the average age of the 5 people increases by 10 years. How old is their grandmother?
items.e: Before: 4 × 22 = 88 years. After: the average is 22 + 10 = 32, so the total is 5 × 32 = 160 years. Grandmother = 160 − 88 = 72 years.

items.q: The average of two numbers is 45. One number is 18 more than the other. What is the bigger number?
items.e: Total = 2 × 45 = 90. 2 units = 90 − 18 = 72, so 1 unit = 36. Bigger number = 36 + 18 = 54.

items.q: In a class, the average mass of the 12 boys is 42 kg and the average mass of the 18 girls is 38 kg. What is the average mass of all the pupils in the class?
items.e: Boys: 12 × 42 = 504 kg. Girls: 18 × 38 = 684 kg. Total = 1,188 kg for 30 pupils. Average = 1,188 ÷ 30 = 39.6 kg. (Not (42 + 38) ÷ 2, because the groups are different sizes.)

items.q: Mr Bello is 3 times as old as his son. Their average age is 26 years. How old is Mr Bello?
items.e: Total age = 2 × 26 = 52 years. 4 units = 52, so 1 unit = 13. Mr Bello = 3 units = 39 years.

items.q: The average age of 5 pupils in a CCA group is 11 years. A coach joins the group, and the average age increases by 2 years. How old is the coach?
items.e: Total age of 5 pupils = 5 × 11 = 55. New total = 6 × 13 = 78. Coach = 78 − 55 = 23 years. (The coach is 10 years older than the new average, enough to add 2 years to each of the 5 pupils.)

items.q: The average height of 5 basketball players is 1.62 m. One player leaves the team. The average height of the other 4 players is 1.60 m. What is the height of the player who left?
The average Maths mark of a class of 40 pupils was 68. Later, the teacher found that one pupil’s mark of 54 should have been 94. What is the correct average mark of the class?
items.e: The total increases by 94 − 54 = 40. Shared among 40 pupils, the average increases by 40 ÷ 40 = 1. Correct average = 68 + 1 = 69.

items.q: The bar graph shows the rainfall at a weather station from July to November. The average monthly rainfall from July to December was 210 mm. What was the rainfall in December?
items.e: Total for 6 months = 6 × 210 = 1,260 mm. July to November = 150 + 250 + 200 + 300 + 100 = 1,000 mm. December = 1,260 − 1,000 = 260 mm.

items.q: The average of three numbers A, B and C is 60. A is twice as big as B. C is 3 times as big as B. What is C?
items.e: Total = 3 × 60 = 180. A + B + C = 2 units + 1 unit + 3 units = 6 units. 6 units = 180, so 1 unit = 30. C = 3 units = 90.

items.q: The average mass of 20 pupils is 40 kg. The average mass of the 8 boys among them is 43 kg. What is the average mass of the girls?
items.e: All: 20 × 40 = 800 kg. Boys: 8 × 43 = 344 kg. Girls: 800 − 344 = 456 kg for 12 girls. Average = 456 ÷ 12 = 38 kg.

items.q: The average of 8 numbers is 25. When 2 of the numbers are removed, the average of the remaining numbers is 22. What is the average of the 2 numbers that were removed?
items.e: Total of 8 numbers = 8 × 25 = 200. Total of the other 6 = 6 × 22 = 132. The 2 numbers add up to 200 − 132 = 68. Average = 68 ÷ 2 = 34.

items.q: The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is 36. What is the largest of the 5 numbers?
items.e: For numbers that go up in equal steps, the average is the middle number. The numbers are 32, 34, 36, 38 and 40. The largest is 40. (Check: 180 ÷ 5 = 36.)

items.q: Temi's scores were Hausa 60, Yoruba 65, English 53, Agricultural Science 68, Igbo 64. What was her average score?
items.e: Total = 310. Average = 310 ÷ 5 = 62.

items.q: Halima's scores were Social Studies 79, Hausa 71, Agricultural Science 96. What was her average score?
items.e: Total = 246. Average = 246 ÷ 3 = 82.

items.q: Peter's scores were English 49, Social Studies 35, Igbo 36, Agricultural Science 35, Mathematics 70. What was his average score?
items.e: Total = 225. Average = 225 ÷ 5 = 45.

items.q: Ruth's scores were English 35, Agricultural Science 34, Mathematics 54. What was her average score?
items.e: Total = 123. Average = 123 ÷ 3 = 41.

items.q: Chidi's scores were Social Studies 43, Mathematics 53, Igbo 48, Agricultural Science 32, Yoruba 49, Basic Science 27. What was his average score?
items.e: Total = 252. Average = 252 ÷ 6 = 42.

items.q: Funke's scores were Agricultural Science 72, Basic Science 51, Igbo 63. What was her average score?
items.e: Total = 186. Average = 186 ÷ 3 = 62.
